research_question: What is the effect of adding platinum-based chemotherapy (carboplatin or cisplatin) to neoadjuvant chemotherapy compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy without platinum on disease-free survival in women with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer?
outcome_description: Disease-free survival (including event-free survival, relapse-free survival, or invasive disease-free survival) measured as a hazard ratio with 95% confidence interval at the longest reported follow-up
positive_direction: A hazard ratio below 1 (or positive effect in log-hazard reduction) indicates prolonged disease-free survival and lower risk of recurrence or death favoring platinum-based chemotherapy
search_queries: neoadjuvant platinum triple negative breast cancer disease free survival randomized trial
carboplatin cisplatin neoadjuvant chemotherapy triple negative breast cancer event free survival trial
platinum neoadjuvant triple-negative breast cancer survival hazard ratio randomized controlled trial
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials evaluating the addition of platinum-based chemotherapy (carboplatin or cisplatin) to neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus the same neoadjuvant regimen without platinum
Studies conducted in women with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer
Studies reporting disease-free survival, event-free survival, relapse-free survival, or invasive disease-free survival as a hazard ratio with 95% confidence interval
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, commentaries, editorials, or theoretical articles)
No comparison between a neoadjuvant platinum arm and a platinum-free control arm, or studies evaluating adjuvant-only platinum therapy

No quantitative outcome data reporting a hazard ratio and 95% confidence interval for disease-free or event-free survival (e.g., only Kaplan-Meier curves without reported HR, or only pathological complete response/overall survival)
Studies restricted to non-triple-negative breast cancer (e.g., HER2-positive or hormone receptor-positive) or unrelated clinical populations
moderators_to_extract: Outcome definition (disease-free survival vs. event-free survival vs. invasive disease-free survival)
effect_size_note: Hazard ratios (HR) and 95% confidence intervals are pooled on the log scale. HR < 1 indicates reduced risk of disease recurrence, progression, or death favoring platinum-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy. If control vs. platinum is reported, the ratio is inverted to platinum vs. control.
